role: Pure sleep-science scoring: fragmentation index, NREM/REM cycle detection, deep/REM half-night architecture, Ohayon age norms and the 0-100 enhanced Sleep score; also rebuilds a SleepData from the timeline editor state and defines SleepData.measuredSleepEfficiency.
types: SleepScienceAnalyzer: enum — namespace of static analysis functions
SleepAnalysis: struct — result bundle, including the enhanced score's sections
EnhancedScoreSections: struct — the enhanced score's six sections in points, exposed on SleepAnalysis.sections
SleepArchitecture: struct — half-night deep/REM distribution + score
AgeAdjustedNorms: struct — expected stage ranges and deviations for an age
HalfNightStages: struct (private) — per-half deep/REM minute accumulator
EnhancedScoreWeights: enum — section points and thresholds of the enhanced score
state: mem:SleepScienceAnalyzer.EnhancedScoreWeights.* (static lets: duration 25, efficiency 20, stageHalf 10, fragmentation 15, cycles 10, architecture 10, ratioCap 1.1, unmeasuredEfficiencyRatio 0.5, unmeasuredSectionRatio 0.5, population deep 20%/REM 25%, deviationPenaltySlope 0.5, cycleLengthHours 1.5, minimumExpectedCycles 3, durationDebt threshold 0.85 / ceiling 90 / floor 60)
toplevel: Static constants above; no global code. EnhancedScoreWeights is also read directly by SleepDetailV2View+Breakdown.swift and HelpScienceAccuracyTests.

flags.text: SleepDetailV2View+Breakdown re-implements the duration, efficiency, stage-half and cycle sub-scores of the enhanced score (rescaled to 0-100) instead of reading the analyzer's per-section values, which it now exposes as SleepAnalysis.sections; until the view reads them, any formula change here (such as this pass's neutral credit for unmeasured continuity/cycles and the below-range stage penalty) must be mirrored by hand there or the breakdown rows disagree with the shown score.

units.does: Sum of the six section points: duration + efficiency + stages + continuity + cycles + architecture (before the duration-debt cap and clamp).
True when the cycle contains any REM minutes (remMinutes > 0); used to count complete cycles in analyze.

Entry point: for a night with nightSleepMinutes > 0 sorts stageIntervals, computes fragmentation/awakenings, and — only when deep or REM minutes are non-nil — cycles, architecture and age norms; then the enhanced score's sections, with continuity unmeasured (nil fragmentation) when the night's wake was not measured (measuredSleepEfficiency nil) and cycles unmeasured (nil count) without stage data, so both score neutral half credit; returns SleepAnalysis (reported fragmentationIndex/cycleCount as measured, enhancedScore, sections) or nil.

flags.text: ARCHITECTURE.md says the enhanced score is used only when stage data is available and the weighted Tier-2 formula is the fallback when no stage breakdown exists (FEATURES.md says the same), but analyze returns non-nil for every night with nightSleepMinutes > 0, stages or not, so calculateSleepScore always returns the enhanced score (which now gives unmeasured sections neutral credit) and the weighted formula runs only for zero-minute nights. The docs still describe the old split.

Adds one interval to the running cycle: REM adds to remMinutes (absorbing any pending post-REM NREM run back into the cycle); NREM before REM adds to nremMinutes; NREM after REM accumulates a pending run and closes the cycle at the run's start once it reaches 15 minutes.

units.does: The enhanced score from its inputs in one call: enhancedScoreSections then enhancedScore(of:). A nil fragmentationIndex (wake not measured) or cycleCount (no stage data) scores that section at unmeasuredSectionRatio. analyze builds the sections itself (it also returns them); this entry is called from tests.
units.entry: XCTest: SleepScienceAnalyzerTests (score helper and enhanced-score cases)

flags.text: No production code calls computeEnhancedScore any more: analyze builds the sections once (enhancedScoreSections) and scores them (enhancedScore(of:)). Only SleepScienceAnalyzerTests call it.

units.does: Final enhanced score: sections.total capped by durationDebtCapped at ratio (night+nap hours)/max(typicalSleepHours,1), clamped to 0-100.

The six sections in points: duration min((night+nap hours)/max(target,1), 1.1)*25; efficiencyRatio*20; stagesScore (0-20); continuity 15*(1-index/100) floored at 0, or 15*0.5 when fragmentationIndex is nil; cycles min(count/expected,1)*10 with expected = max(3, nightHours/1.5), or 10*0.5 when cycleCount is nil; architecture score/100*10.

branches.effect: continuity = fragmentationPoints * unmeasuredSectionRatio (7.5)
cycles = cyclePoints * unmeasuredSectionRatio (5)

units.does: Efficiency section ratio: 0.5 when efficiency was not measured; else measured efficiency / (age-expected efficiency, or SleepConstants.goodEfficiency 85) capped at 1.1.

branches.effect: false: returns 0.5 (neutral); true: computes ratio
no age norms: population 85% used

units.does: Stage section (0-20): deep half + REM half via stageHalf, passing the age-expected deep/REM range when norms exist; a stage with nil minutes gets neutral 5; a zero-minute night returns 10.

branches.effect: false: returns stageHalfPoints (10, i.e. both halves neutral); true: scores halves
nil stage minutes contribute neutral 5 points each

units.does: One stage's 0-10 points from its share of the night: without an expected range, share / population target * 10 capped at 10; with one, full 10 at or above the range's lower bound, else 10 - (lowerBound - share)*0.5 floored at 0, so the score falls smoothly from the lower bound.

branches.effect: true: population-target formula; false: continue

branches.cond: share at or above the lower bound
branches.effect: true: full 10 points; false (below range): penalised by distance below the bound

units.does: Duration-debt cap: when (night+nap)/target < 0.85, caps total at 60 + ratio/0.85*30 (90 at threshold, 60 at 0); otherwise returns total unchanged.

branches.effect: false: returns total; true: min(total, ceiling)
